rationale: With only 7 minutes to close, any position would be liquidated at market, creating unacceptable slippage risk on a stock that gapped down nearly 8% and is trading near its session low with no clear directional catalyst. The last 5 candles show a brief uptick on elevated volume but the price is still below VWAP ($28.92) and the range position (15.4%) offers insufficient room for a meaningful risk/reward setup within the remaining time. The ATR of ~$0.08 on 5-minute bars is too small relative to spread and execution risk to justify a trade this close to forced liquidation.
